# UI

Kit: Ark UI. Styling: Tailwind CSS v4. Tokens: tokens/ (terrazzo).

## Rules
1. Reuse a kit component before writing a new one; compose with the existing props.
2. Colours, spacing, radius, fonts and motion come from tokens (table below). No raw hex, no arbitrary values, no primitives.
3. After UI changes run `pnpm run check`.
4. Honour prefers-reduced-motion; give every animated or WebGL element a static fallback.

## Lookup
- See the kit documentation.
- Icons: Lucide; import individual icons only.
